info.name: Sprint 12 - Socket.io Chat
info.description:
Checks for the Socket.io chat server.

HTTP requests in this collection verify the server is up and that the Socket.io handshake endpoint responds.

For the WebSocket test, create a NEW WebSocket request in Postman (New > WebSocket) and use:

URL: ws://localhost:5000/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket

Then send these messages in order (also in websocket-packets.txt):

1. 40
2. 42["join room",{"room":"General"}]
3. 42["chat message",{"username":"Postman","message":"Hello from Postman","room":"General","sentAt":1}]
4. 42["typing",{"username":"Postman","room":"General"}]
5. 42["stop typing",{"username":"Postman","room":"General"}]

Reply 3 whenever the server sends 2 (keep-alive ping).
